steps.text: Hi, you've reached {{bank_name}}. I'm the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded.
Hi Chloe, how can I help you today?
Hey, I can't find my card. I think I left it at a restaurant last night. Can you stop it?

steps.summary: Chloe thinks she left her debit card at a restaurant.

steps.text: No stress, we'll sort it. I've sent a notification to your banking app, so just tap Approve and I'll know it's you.
Thanks Chloe. One moment, I'm just finding your card.
I can see your debit card ending in four one four eight. I'll put a temporary lock on it now.
All done, your card's locked. It's a temporary lock, so if it turns up you can unlock it in the app.
The last purchase I can see was at {{lock_card.last_transaction.merchant|a shop listed in your app}}. Does that sound right?

steps.summary: Card ending 4148 temporarily locked. Chloe recognised the last transaction.

steps.text: Lovely. I've texted you a confirmation, and your reference is {{lock_card.case_number|in that message}}. Anything else I can do?
No, that's it. Thanks so much!
